args.command:
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util
import pathlib
import sys

question_test = pathlib.Path('/testbed/qa_instances_eval/qtile/backend_wayland_inputs_direct_repeat_key_max_call_depth/files/tests/qa/backend_wayland_inputs_direct_repeat_key_max_call_depth_test.py')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('qa_test_mod', question_test)
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules['qa_test_mod'] = mod
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

TARGETS = {
    str(pathlib.Path('/testbed/libqtile/backend/wayland/inputs.py').resolve()),
    str(pathlib.Path('/testbed/libqtile/backend/wayland/window.py').resolve()),
}

current_depth = 0
max_depth = 0

def tracer(frame, event, arg):
    global current_depth, max_depth
    filename = str(pathlib.Path(frame.f_code.co_filename).resolve())
    if filename in TARGETS:
        if event == 'call':
            current_depth += 1
            if current_depth > max_depth:
                max_depth = current_depth
        elif event in ('return', 'exception'):
            current_depth -= 1
    return tracer

# run the exact test method body
case = mod.TestBackendWaylandInputsDirectRepeatKeyMaxCallDepthQA()
sys.settrace(tracer)
try:
    case.test_backend_wayland_inputs_direct_repeat_key_max_call_depth_case()
finally:
    sys.settrace(None)

print('max_depth', max_depth)
print('current_depth_end', current_depth)
PY
